## Details

CodeBoarding is an AI-augmented static analysis platform that maps and documents complex codebases through a hierarchical, agentic workflow, transforming raw source code into structured architectural insights and visual documentation.

### Language Runtime & Tooling Manager [[Expand]](./Language_Runtime_Tooling_Manager.md)
Handles the environment bootstrapping, platform-specific binary downloads, and installation of language-specific LSP servers and runtimes required for static analysis.

### Structural Validation & Delta Analysis [[Expand]](./Structural_Validation_Delta_Analysis.md)
Validates the integrity of the generated component graphs by checking edges against the CFG and calculating structural diffs during incremental updates.

## Details

Manages the core agent lifecycle, LLM configuration, and the discovery of project dependencies to provide context for the analysis agents.

### Specialized Agent Strategies & Prompt Engineering [[Expand]](./Specialized_Agent_Strategies_Prompt_Engineering.md)
Implements the concrete logic for different analysis stages and manages provider-specific prompt templates using a factory pattern.

## Details

Acts as the central coordinator for the static analysis lifecycle, managing engine configurations, atomic caching, and Leiden algorithm utilities for codebase partitioning.

## Details

Analyzes the quality and stability of evolved clusters by evaluating metrics like cohesion, coupling, and circular dependencies to identify structural debt.

### Structural & Complexity Metrics Engine
Implements the core suite of architectural checks that evaluate the internal quality of code units, including coupling, cohesion, and anti-pattern identification.

## Details

Serves as the primary interface for external automation, handling environment setup, depth-level resolution, and the generation of final documentation artifacts in Markdown, HTML, MDX, and RST formats.

### Workflow Orchestrator & CLI Engine [[Expand]](./Workflow_Orchestrator_CLI_Engine.md)
Acts as the primary entry point for the application, responsible for parsing commands, resolving local paths, and dispatching specific analysis workflows.

## Details

Provides low-level diffing logic and validation rules to identify modified code segments, normalizing paths and calculating fingerprint differences.

### Incremental Change Detector

## Details

The core engine for calculating architectural shifts between versions, materializing snapshots, and calculating structural differences at language and cluster levels.

## Details

Manages the initialization and validation of the system state, including user-defined LLM provider configurations and pre-flight health checks.

### System Configuration & Health Orchestrator
Acts as the primary entry point for system initialization. It handles the parsing of user-defined configurations for LLM providers and coordinates the execution of both local and remote health checks to ensure the environment is fit for analysis.

## Details

Manages the lifecycle of LSP clients and provides the base abstraction for all language interactions, including environment preparation and specialized logic for compiled or strictly structured languages.

Manages the lifecycle of architectural clusters across versions, calculating structural differences and handling cluster merging during incremental analysis.

## Details

Coordinates the high-level logic for building and updating the codebase model, managing cross-boundary edges, and handling incremental updates.

### Static Analysis Engine & Edge Resolver [[Expand]](./Static_Analysis_Engine_Edge_Resolver.md)

## Details

Centralizes the logic for selecting, initializing, and configuring LLM providers, managing model-specific capabilities, and providing a unified interface for agents.

## Details

Provides specialized interface implementations for different programming languages, configuring interactions with LSP servers and ensuring correct initialization.

### Core Adapter Orchestrator & Compiled Language Adapters [[Expand]](./Core_Adapter_Orchestrator_Compiled_Language_Adapters.md)
Manages the lifecycle of LSP clients and provides the base abstraction for all language interactions, including environment preparation and specialized logic for compiled or strictly structured languages.

### Web & Enterprise Language Adapters [[Expand]](./Web_Enterprise_Language_Adapters.md)

## Details

The core engine responsible for the deterministic construction of the call graph, managing context for edge building and resolving symbol definitions.

### Reference-Based Edge Resolver
Specializes in the granular resolution of call graph edges by analyzing symbol references and implementation queries, leveraging LSP data to map call sites to target symbols.

## Details

Provides the foundational static analysis capabilities, including repository state hashing, language-specific configuration scanning, and persistent analysis caching.

### Analysis Orchestrator & Partitioning Engine [[Expand]](./Analysis_Orchestrator_Partitioning_Engine.md)
Acts as the central coordinator for the static analysis lifecycle, managing engine configurations, atomic caching, and Leiden algorithm utilities for codebase partitioning.

## Details

Validates the integrity of the generated component graphs by checking edges against the CFG and calculating structural diffs during incremental updates.

### Delta Calculation & Cluster Evolution Engine [[Expand]](./Delta_Calculation_Cluster_Evolution_Engine.md)
